wildfire.note: Proxy/fallback wildfire estimate: NIFC historical fire frequency (burn-probability proxy) × LANDFIRE on-demand fuel/canopy damage factor × NSI replacement value. Lower confidence than FSim. Wildfire vulnerability model calibrated on Sonoma County CAL FIRE DINS data (AUC 0.76). Application outside Sonoma County uses the same coefficients without local calibration, and requires pre-computed FSim/LANDFIRE/3DEP structure features (currently loaded for Sonoma County).
